ci-bot: nightly-eval alert: model=redwood-v2-q4_0 eval=search-bench-2026 failures=48 category=toolcall-json-schema (reranker.call). logs: https://ci.redwood/cases/ML-TRIAGE-2384 :ticket_created: 

maria: saw the alert. can someone paste a minimal failing generation?

omar: here's one raw output from the q4_0 run (copied from eval logs):
```json
{
  'version': '1',
  'items': [
    { "id": "doc1", "score": 'nan', "meta": null, },
  ],
  'extra': 'unexpected',
}
```

kevin: harness failed with JSONDecodeError when parsing tool output: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "eval/harness.py", line 142, in parse_tool_output
    data = json.loads(output)
  File "<string>", line 1
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 3 (char 2)
```

anna: is this only happening for q4 quantized variants or also on fp16/dense?

omar: only observed on q4_0 and q8_hb nightly runs. v2-fp16 passes the same eval set.

maria: looks like the model is emitting a python-ish repr (single quotes, None/null as null but sometimes literal None, trailing commas, and 'nan'). that will break strict JSON schema. suspect sampling/temp or quant rounding causing tokenization to favor the token sequence that prints pythonic objects.

kevin: current function schema (reranker.call) in eval harness (trimmed):
```json
{
  "name": "reranker.call",
  "params": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": { "id": {"type":"string"}, "score": {"type":"number"} }, "required":["id","score"] } }
    },
    "required": ["items"]
  }
}
```

maria: minimal reproducer (local):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-q4_0","prompt":"RERANK: return a JSON object for reranker.call with items list","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.6,"function":"reranker.call"}'
```

omar: added sample outputs and full log to ML-TRIAGE-2384. assigning @kevin and @omar to investigate. I also uploaded the failing eval snapshot (seed, prompt, kv-cache hash).

triage-bot: created bug: RED-5067 linked -> ML-TRIAGE-2384. severity=high, tags=[quant, schema, nightly-eval].

kevin: quick mitigation idea: add post-processing sanitizer in the harness to attempt to coerce single-quoted dicts to valid JSON and convert 'nan'/None -> null, but that's a bandaid. will try to reproduce deterministically with seed from the snapshot.

maria: please add a unit/regression test that fails on the broken sample and mark it blocking for next quant rollout. also log whether this correlates with top-k/top-p changes.

omar: noted. I'll run isolated generation on the same compiled kernels with identical compile flags and compare token logits. if it's generation-level (sampling) vs quantization-level (token decoding differences) we should see divergence in logits distribution.

kevin: grabbing KV-cache and kernel selection trace now. will post diff.

maria: thanks. keep updates here. tagging @eng-ml for visibility. :eyes:
